The General Settings module is used to configure fundamental details about the library's operations. This includes basic information such as the library's name, phone number, address, and language settings. Proper configuration ensures accurate communication and representation of the library.

Fields and Descriptions

Library Name:

  • Description: The official name of the library.
  • Usage: Enter the full name of the library as it should appear in all official documents and communications.
  • Example: "City Central Library"
  • Validation: Must be a valid and accurate name of the library.

Phone:

  • Description: The contact phone number for the library.
  • Usage: Enter the primary phone number for library inquiries and communication.
  • Example: "+1-555-1234"
  • Validation: Must be a valid phone number format.

Address:

  • Description: The physical address of the library.
  • Usage: Enter the full address of the library, including street address, city, state, and ZIP code.
  • Example: "123 Library Lane, Booktown, CA 90001"
  • Validation: Must be a valid address format that includes all necessary components.

Language:

  • Description: The default language for the library management system interface.
  • Usage: Select the language in which the library system's interface and communications will be displayed.
  • Example: "English", "Spanish"
  • Validation: Must be a valid language code or name supported by the system.
